content:
Returns the single administrator object, with the same information as Retrieve
Administrators plus:
activation_url
Link to the activation form if an activation link exists for that
admin.
subaccount_role
The administrator's role when accessing a subaccount. One
of: "Owner", "Administrator", "Application Manager", "User
Manager", "Security Analyst", "Help Desk", "Billing", or
"Read-only". Only present in the response if the customer
edition includes the Administrative Roles feature and the
customer is an MSP customer, has the Accounts API feature,
or has existing subaccounts.
"last_directory_sync": null,
"last_login": null,
"name": "Rachael Scott",
"password_change_required": false,
"phone": null,
"phone_details": [],
"restricted_by_admin_units": false,
"role": "Help Desk",
"status": "Pending Activation"
}
}
GET  /admin/v1/admins/[admin_id]
